description.value: Sunview Market is a farm market in British Columbia's Okanagan & Thompson region, an area renowned for its orchards, vineyards, and roadside produce stands. Tagged in OpenStreetMap as a farm shop, it likely offers locally grown fruit and vegetables direct from producers — a welcome stop for cyclists touring the fruit-belt routes of the South Okanagan. The specific product mix and facilities are unverified due to website access issues.
